name: Carlo Masi
summary: Ruggero Freddi is an Italian mathematics lecturer and former gay pornographic film actor known professionally as Carlo Masi. He was married to a member of the Roman noble family Del Drago, holding the title of prince, and became his widower following his husband's death.
